title: On Existing only in the oldest accounts
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：exist　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exist 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the old rule ① existed only in the oldest accounts twice over, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the old rule ② exists only in the oldest accounts year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ exist only in the oldest accounts at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ existed only in the oldest accounts before — a line in the programme for September 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Existing only in the oldest accounts twice over, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the old rule ever ⑥ exists on bread and water alone year after year before the September rains, nobody in the stadium would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ exist on bread and water alone year after year and never speak of it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a second rule ⑧ exists on bread and water alone twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the stadium said a word; ⑨ The old rule existed only in the oldest accounts again in 1965, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To exist only in the oldest accounts, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, the old rule exists only in the oldest accounts year after year again and the old rule must exist only in the oldest accounts twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 存在于（一般过去式 existed only in the oldest accounts：1955 年那条老规矩头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 存在于（一般现在 exists only in the oldest accounts：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 存在于（不定式 to exist only in the oldest accounts：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 存在于（过去完成时 had existed only in the oldest accounts：1949 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 存在于（动名词 existing only in the oldest accounts 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 活着（exists on bread and water alone：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真活着只靠面包和水活着）
G. v. 活着（exist on bread and water alone：let it 之后的原形，指随它去只靠面包和水活着）
H. v. 存在于（后段两处：后来的那条老规矩照例 exists on bread and water alone，而那条老规矩在 1965 年又一次 existed only in the oldest accounts）

answers.why: exist 意为“存在于”，1955 年那条老规矩来回两遍存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 existed。
exist 意为“存在于”，自那以后那条老规矩年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 exists。
exist 意为“存在于”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里”，此处为不定式 to exist only in the oldest accounts。
exist 意为“存在于”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人存在于过，故用过去完成时 had existed。
exist 意为“存在于”，那条老规矩说“存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 existing only in the oldest accounts 作主语。
exist 意为“活着”，叔叔说的是“万一那条老规矩真活着只靠面包和水活着”，if 从句里用一般现在 exists on bread and water alone。
exist 意为“活着”，老手们的规矩是“随它活着只靠面包和水活着”（let it exist on bread and water alone），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
exist 意为“存在于”，后来的那条老规矩每个年份都照例活着只靠面包和水活着，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 exists。
exist 意为“存在于”，那条老规矩在 1965 年在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里，用一般过去式 existed 叙述。
exist 意为“存在于”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，那条老规矩来回两遍存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里；体育场里每一个陪练都说这是头一回。（existed only in the oldest accounts）
多年以后，那条老规矩仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（exists only in the oldest accounts）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里这件事本身。（to exist only in the oldest accounts）
早在 1949 年就有人存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里，九月那天秩序册上的一行字就是证据。（had existed only in the oldest accounts）
那条老规矩说过，来回两遍存在于只存在于最老的那些记载里这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（existing only in the oldest accounts 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它活着只靠面包和水活着，以后再也不要提起。（let it exist on bread and water alone）
answers: In 1955 the old rule existed only in the oldest accounts twice over, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the old rule still exists only in the oldest accounts year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to exist only in the oldest accounts at all was the part nobody had expected.
The old rule had existed only in the oldest accounts long before 1962, and the line in the programme for September proves it.
Existing only in the oldest accounts twice over, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it exist on bread and water alone year after year and never speak of it again.

answers: In 1955 the old rule existed only in the oldest accounts twice over, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the old rule exists only in the oldest accounts year after year whenever the stadium asks.
